_comment: 推荐优先级：硬阻断 > 实用(0.4) > 美观(0.35) > 舒适(0.25)

hard_blocks._comment: 不通过直接淘汰。逐条检查，命中任一条即淘汰。

rules.desc: 气温≥30°C禁止厚外套(羊毛/皮质/灯芯绒)，薄款冲锋衣/工装夹克可穿；商务/约会豁免
rules.check: weather_temp >= 30 and cat_code == 'JK' and ('羊毛' in fabric_primary or '皮质' in fabric_primary or '灯芯绒' in fabric_primary) and occasion not in ('商务', '正式', '约会')

rules.desc: 气温≥35°C禁止长袖上衣(薄款也不行)
气温≥32°C禁止大黄靴/厚底靴
rules.check: weather_temp >= 32 and cat_code == 'SHOE' and '靴' in fabric_primary

rules.desc: 气温≥35°C禁止任何外套
气温≤12°C 禁止短裤（背心可作内搭不拦）
气温≤8°C 禁止帆布鞋/拖鞋
rules.check: weather_temp <= 8 and cat_code == 'SHOE' and ('帆布' in fabric_primary or 'Puma' in item.brand.name)

rules.desc: (已移除——改为实用层加分)
雨天/雪天禁止白色/米白/奶油色下装
rules.check: weather_cond in ('雨', '暴雨', '雷雨', '雪') and cat_code in ('SH', 'PT') and hue_name in ('白色', '米白', '米白色', '象牙白', '奶油色', '浅米色')

rules.desc: 雨天禁止皮质鞋/翻毛皮鞋
rules.check: weather_cond in ('雨', '暴雨', '雷雨') and cat_code == 'SHOE' and ('皮质' in fabric_primary or '皮' in fabric_primary)

rules.desc: 商务/正式场合禁止短裤
rules.check: occasion in ('商务', '正式') and cat_code == 'SH'

rules.desc: 商务/正式/约会场合禁止球衣/运动外套
rules.check: occasion in ('商务', '正式', '约会') and item.clothing_id in ('TS-007', 'JK-001')

rules.desc: 商务/正式场合禁止运动鞋/足球鞋
rules.check: occasion in ('商务', '正式') and cat_code == 'SHOE' and item.clothing_id in ('SHOE-003', 'SHOE-008')

rules.desc: 运动场景必须有运动鞋，禁止皮鞋/靴子/帆布鞋
rules.check: occasion == '运动' and cat_code == 'SHOE' and item.clothing_id in ('SHOE-001', 'SHOE-002', 'SHOE-004', 'SHOE-006', 'SHOE-007', 'SHOE-009')

rules.desc: 运动场景禁戴手串（Apple Watch ACC-003 推荐佩戴）
运动场景禁止牛仔裤/西裤
rules.check: occasion == '运动' and cat_code == 'PT' and item.clothing_id in ('PT-001', 'PT-005', 'PT-006')

rules.desc: 禁止推荐两条裤子或两条短裤
禁止推荐两双鞋
禁止同时穿两件外套
约会/聚会禁止穿球衣
rules.check: occasion in ('约会', '聚会') and item.clothing_id == 'TS-007'

rules.desc: 约会禁止只穿背心（可内搭）
rules.check: occasion == '约会' and cat_code == 'TANK' and outfit_level: tank_only

rules.desc: (约会/商务不因高温拦外套的豁免已在规则1中处理)
上衣+下装+鞋子三件套齐全
面料含当前季节
高温晴天有帽子/墨镜
rules.check: weather_temp >= 30 and weather_cond == '晴' and any(item.category_code in ('HAT','SUN') for item in outfit)

rules.desc: 低温有外套/长袖
rules.check: weather_temp <= 15 and any(item.category_code in ('JK','LS') for item in outfit)

rules.desc: 雨天有防水/深色单品
配色协调无冲突撞色
单品风格分≥30
上宽下窄/外松内紧
偏瘦体型修饰
棉/麻/丝面料
rules.check: '棉' in fabric_primary or '麻' in fabric_primary or '亚麻' in fabric_primary

rules.desc: 日常宽松版型
rules.check: fit == '宽松' and occasion in ('日常','休闲')

rules.desc: 衬偏白肤色
历史偏好加成
